settings.uairctl.label: uairctl command
settings.uairctl.description: Path to the uairctl binary used to talk to the running uair daemon.
settings.interval.label: Refresh interval (ms)
settings.interval.description: How often the remaining time is re-read from uair.
settings.glyphRunning.label: Running glyph
settings.glyphPaused.label: Paused glyph
settings.labelFormat.label: Bar label format
settings.labelFormat.description: Text shown on the bar. {name} is the uair session name (working, resting, ...), {time} the remaining time with any padding zero trimmed, {minutes} the minutes left rounded to nearest (seconds once under a minute), and {min_unit} the matching "min"/"mins" (or "sec"/"secs").
